verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own docs say it supports managing multiple companies (entities) under one login, which covers the multi-entity management half of the story. Consolidated financials appear only through a separate Joiin integration for multi-entity reporting, not as a native consolidation feature. missing for 10: native consolidated financial statements across entities, documentation of intercompany eliminations and consolidation workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can manage multiple legal entities and produce consolidated financials across them

citations.quote: Puzzle supports managing multiple companies (entities) under one login.
